purpose: Review first-party Mali cadastral channels for anonymous Sikasso parcel geometry with safe native identifiers.
assessment: Official DGDC/DNDC pages evidence Mali cadastral authority and a DRDC/Sikasso regional office. The current public JavaScript/configuration exposes anonymous cadastre APIs, but the live catalog contains only Bamako/Kati layers. A bounded Sikasso vicinity request on a documented Bamako layer returned no features; no Sikasso parcel geometry or native ID was verified.
registryAssessment: A local/regional custodian is evidenced by the official regional-services page listing DRDC/SIKASSO. This does not establish an open, complete or citywide digital parcel registry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DGDC/DNDC national cadastral mandate with communal/local/regional organization and DRDC/Sikasso custody; DGI NINACAD-ADRESSE article claims project coverage including Sikasso.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous route discovery, six-layer catalog, one non-Sikasso schema sample, and a bounded Sikasso-bbox test on an existing Bamako layer.

officialPrimarySources.scope: Official regional-services directory listing DRDC/Sikasso; local custody evidence.
Official national cadastral mandate, communal organization, unique NINACAD concept and cadastral functions.
Official project announcement stating NINACAD-ADRESSE coverage includes Sikasso; no public parcel API supplied.
Current public portal and service-link/configuration discovery.

searchQueries.query: Sikasso Mali official cadastral map parcel land registry GIS cadastre
searchQueries.result: Official DGDC/DNDC portal, cadastre page, regional services page and DGI NINACAD-ADRESSE article found; no open Sikasso parcel layer verified.

searchQueries.result: Les pages officielles DGDC/DNDC confirment la compétence cadastrale et la DRDC/Sikasso; aucune couche publique anonyme de parcelles de Sikasso n'a été vérifiée.

attempts: Fetched the official DGDC homepage and regional-services page anonymously over TLS; both returned HTTP 200.
Inspected the current homepage JavaScript/configuration and fetched the referenced dgdc-portail JavaScript; public API base was https://dndc.gouv.ml/wp-json/dgdc/v1.
Fetched the anonymous API root; cadastre layer catalog, metadata, parcel-by-ID and GeoJSON routes were present. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass or unsafe field request was used.
Fetched the public layer catalog; six layers were returned and all reported Bamako/Kati bounds. No Sikasso layer or Sikasso-specific layer code was present.
Fetched metadata for aci2000; HTTP 200, featureCount 2994, Bamako bounds, no explicit CRS field.
Fetched one bounded non-Sikasso aci2000 GeoJSON feature for schema inspection only; native id/parcelleId and geometry were observed in ignored scratch, with no retained sample or raw attributes.
Requested the documented aci2000 GeoJSON route with bbox=-5.68,11.30,-5.66,11.33 and limit=3 around the unchanged WUP point; HTTP 200 empty FeatureCollection. This is not treated as citywide absence.
Requested the documented aci2000 parcels route with the same bounded bbox and limit; HTTP 400 reported parcel number required. No broad listing was attempted.
Did not shift the exact WUP point, did not request owner/address/titleholder/contact/tax/account/personal fields, and retained zero parcel polygons.
Runtime adapter qualification was not attempted; runtime readiness remains held.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: Not a citywide parcel test; only a bounded bbox request against an existing Bamako layer was run.

requestEvidence.assessment: Empty response from non-Sikasso/Bamako-bounded layer; no absence inference.
Parcel number required; no city parcel response.

nativeSchema.crs: Not explicitly supplied by the public GeoJSON response; observed coordinates are GeoJSON [longitude, latitude] on the non-Sikasso sample.
nativeSchema.nativeFieldMapping: Non-Sikasso schema only: feature.id and properties.parcelleId are stable identity candidates; geometry is GeoJSON geometry. No Sikasso mapping was established.

nextStep: Recheck the official DGDC catalog for a published Sikasso/NINACAD layer in a later attempt; retain at most three full polygons only after a bounded Sikasso response supplies stable native IDs and geometry.
remainingUncertainty: Sikasso holdings may be unpublished, offline, authenticated, or not yet exposed through the public layer catalog. The empty bbox response is limited to a Bamako layer and cannot establish citywide absence.
